name: God is in the Radio
source:
WE ALL DESIRE THE LIFE, ETERNAL! THE WARMTH, ETERNAL! THE HAPPINESS, ETERNAL!

You're The Death, one of 22 members of the Major Arcana, a cult dedicated to some far-off god. The night is Halloween, and you watch in scorn as the unknowing dance among devils and dress to indulge in sin. The High Priestess receives a message from the all-mighty himself: The Arcana must gather in an abandoned house and find his song on an old radio receiver. By finding his gift, he will grant you the life, eternal, and the world will finally be able to hear his light.

Are you scared of what's to come? Do you doubt the cult and its god? Or do you embrace it with open arms?

[Edited from [url=https://catsket.itch.io/intheradio]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们渴望永恒的生命！永恒的温暖！永恒的幸福！

你是死神，隶属大阿尔卡那教团的22名成员之一。这个邪教崇拜一位遥远的神明。今夜是万圣节，你轻蔑地看着浑然不知的人们在恶魔之间起舞，盛装纵情于罪恶。女祭司收到全能神亲自传来的讯息：大阿尔卡那必须聚集在一栋废弃房屋里，从一台老式收音机中找到祂的歌声。只要找到祂赐下的礼物，祂便会赐予你们永恒的生命，而全世界终将听见祂的光辉。

你害怕即将发生的一切吗？你怀疑这个教团和它的神吗？还是会张开双臂欣然接受？
